title_zh: 免費網上培訓：如何診斷有／無共病的 ADHD——實證評估入門（12 月 16 日，Luis Augusto Rohde）
title_en: World Federation ADHD webinar diagnose ADHD comorbidity December 2026
summary_zh: 世界 ADHD 聯合會免費每月網上講座系列，下一場為 2026 年 12 月 16 日 13:00（柏林時間，約香港時間 20:00），由巴西南里奧格蘭德聯邦大學精神病學教授 Luis Augusto Rohde 主講「如何診斷有／無共病的 ADHD？」。內容涵蓋 DSM-5 與 ICD-11 核心症狀評估、評定量表、結構化晤談、共病識別、鑑別診斷與補充評估策略。對象為心理健康專業人員（包括心理學家、精神科醫生）、基層醫療與兒科醫生。費用全免，登記經 Microsoft Forms 連結；過往講座錄影設於網上圖書館。
summary_en: The World Federation of ADHD's free monthly live webinar series holds its next session on 16 December 2026 at 1:00 p.m. Berlin time (about 8:00 p.m. Hong Kong time), with Professor Luis Augusto Rohde of the Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, presenting 'How to diagnose ADHD in people without & with comorbidity?'. It covers evidence-based ADHD assessment across the lifespan: core symptoms under DSM-5 and ICD-11, rating scales, structured interviews, identifying co-occurring conditions, differential diagnosis and complementary assessment strategies. It is aimed at mental health professionals (including psychologists and psychiatrists), primary care professionals and paediatricians. Attendance is free; registration is via a Microsoft Forms link; recordings of past webinars are available in the online library.
